about: Contrecœur is a city on the south shore of the St. Lawrence in Montérégie, Quebec, northeast of Montréal toward Sorel-Tracy. An old seigneury village core, a major steelworks on the river, and remaining farmland define this industrial-and-rural riverside city. About 9,000 people live in Contrecœur.
seoSummary: Montérégie St. Lawrence city northeast of Montréal—historic village core and riverfront steelworks.
